big_case.notes: The staged question concerns California litigation privilege, alleged acquisition of private law-enforcement records, and amendment of privacy claims after an unpublished Ninth Circuit affirmance. The privacy and amendment issues matter to the parties, but the record shows no developed federal conflict or broad institutional change, and the petition ended in an ordinary denial.
